title: Express Glitter (ver5.0.0)
content: **Objective** Express various glitter with different color. **Location** Object Browser ▶ Property Editor (Select Fabric) ▶ Material ▶ Type ▶ **Glitter (Render Only)** ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser ▶ Property Editor (Select Fabric) ▶ Material ▶ Type **▶ Glitter (Render Only) ** ※Note: To preview the glitter, please navigate to the Main Menu ▶ Render ▶ Render ▶ [Interactive Render](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014784747-Run-V-Ray-Render). 2. Refer to the below table and express the desired glitter by modifying the properties. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Glitter Parameters** | Color | Set glitter color. Number | Set the number of the glitter particles. Higher the value is, more the glitter particles are, and vice-versa. ![size.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360016896653/size.png) Saturation Variation | Randomize each glitter particle's color. When the value is 0, there's no variation to the color, showing the color set by the user. On the other hand, more color appear when the value is 1. ※Note: When one of the R, G, B values of the color is dominant, saturation variation occurs within the corresponding color value. In the above case, you may not see various color. To express various color, please set R, G, B values similarly. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360016142614/mceclip0.png)
content_description: Discover how to customize and express a variety of glitter effects in your fabric designs using the Glitter (Render Only) feature in the Property Editor.

title: CLO X EcoShot
content: ## **New in 2025.0** Seamlessly composite realistic clothing images rendered in CLO onto EcoShot avatars to create lifelike images. ![42 CLO X EcoShot.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46092011278361) 1. Click Plugins » **EcoShot** menu in the top menu. 2. Enter your E-mail and click **LOG IN** button. 3. on EcoShot page, click **Grant** button to authorize access. 4. Return to CLO and set the avatar’s gender, type, and pose. 5. Click **Add to Workspace** button to open the configurated avatar into 3D window. 6. Drape the garment on the added avatar. 7. In EcoShot window, click ![Interactive Render On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46092028106009) **Preview** button to view the composite result of the draped garment combined with the EcoShot avatar. 8. Click ![Final Render On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46092028110745) **Send Image Request** button to generate the high-quality composite image. 9. Click ![Show in Saved Folder On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46092028113817) **EcoShot ImageHub** button to check active requests or completed images on the webpage.
content_description: Discover how to effortlessly create lifelike images by compositing realistic clothing rendered in CLO onto EcoShot avatars with our step-by-step guide.

title: Set Default Files
content: Change the default settings of the software menu according to user preference in User Settings. Upon restarting, the user settings of the software becomes the default settings. Shortcut keys, menus, graphic options, view controls, default files, font settings and other miscellaneous properties can be set in User Settings. #### 1. Click the Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶**Default Files** **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Project** | Define the file path for the default file that is loaded when starting the program. **Save with Thumbnail (PNG)** | ## ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44192924896153) By default, only the project(ZPRJ)/garment(ZPAC) file is saved without a separate thumbnail image (PNG), and it is immediately previewed as a file thumbnail. ![File Explorer.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44195781411097) **📝 ****Note:** The thumbnail image can be saved alogn with the project file if needed. **Current Viewpoint** | Save thumbnail images based on the current 3D viewpoint. **4 Viewpoints** | Save thumbnails as multi-view images from 4 viewpoints (front, right, back, left). The 3D viewpoint is automatically adjusted to fit the garment, not all objects. **Custom Viewpoints** | Open a multi-view snapshot file (MVS) and save it according to the set options. **Avatar ** | **Permission File** | Define Avatar Permission(AVTP) or Alvanon Permission (APF) File's file path. **Material** | **Fabric** | Define the file path for the default fabric physical properties file (PSP). **Texture Images** | ** Open from ** | Assign the default path to load texture images. ** Refresh from Custom Folder Path ** | Define the file path to be used when refreshing textures. **Simulation Property** | Define the file path for the default simulation property (MSTP) file. **Auto Save** | **Time Interval (min)** | Adjust the time interval for auto-saving. **File ****Type/Path** | Define the file type and the saving path for auto-saved files. **Custom Color Palette** | Define the file path for the default color palette (ACO) file. **Garment Information** | Define the file path for the default garment information file.
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on customizing software default settings in User Settings to enhance user experience by allowing personalized configurations for files, views, and other essential properties.

title: Washing File (JEAN) of Jeanologia Import/ Export
content: **List of Contents** **Import JEAN File** **Export JEAN File** **Objective** Import a washing file(JEAN) of eDesigner, which is an application of [Jeanologia](https://www.jeanologia.com/) offering laser washing solution, and apply it on a garment as a graphic. When exporting a tech pack(JSON), the applied and edited washing can be exported as JEAN file again. **📝Note:** To import or export JEAN file, eDesigner Plugin must be installed on PC. **Location ** **Import JEAN File** 3D/2D Toolbar ▶ [Graphic (3D/2D Pattern) tool](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/115000483967-%EA%B7%B8%EB%9E%98%ED%94%BD-%EC%83%9D%EC%84%B1) **Export JEAN File** File ▶ Export ▶ **Jean (JEAN)** **Operation ** **Import JEAN File** 1. Click the tool/menu indicated in Location. → **Open File** window appears. ** ** 2. Click JEAN file. → **eDesigner Login** window appears. 3. Enter the ID and PW of eDesigner then click **Login** button. → The washing image is previewed in the**Import JEAN File** window. 4. Refer to the table below and import JEAN file by clicking the desired option. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Apply All** | Automatically identifies the face of the pattern and all washing images of JEAN file are applied. This functions normally by the type of pants, edit the JEAN file exported from CLO in eDesigner, then import it back to apply to the same garment. When a garment and JEAN file are not corresponding, you can miss the washing file or position and scale may not be matching. Import the missing image individually. **OK (Apply a single image)** | Adds a single washing image that appeared in the **Import JEAN file** window. To apply a washing to the double layers like a back pocket of pants, refer to the contents below. 1) Copy the back pattern piece that applied a washing image. 2) Cut the Internal Shape/ Baseline of the pocket in the back pattern piece. 3) Sew the cut pocket pattern piece onto the back pattern again. 4) Delete the original pocket and the remaining pattern pieces. **※Note:** Drag and drop a JEAN file from Library or OS Dialogue to 3D/2D window. ** Export JEAN File** 1. Click the tool/ menu indicated in Location. → Export File window appears. 2. Designate the file saving path and name the file, then click **OK**. **※Note:** * Due to eDesigner supports only PNG format, you must export a graphic in PNG. * You can only export a graphic by following the steps: [Graphic Properties ▶ Classification ▶ Wash (Jeanologia)](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/360049969394-%EA%B7%B8%EB%9E%98%ED%94%BD-%EC%86%8D%EC%84%B1) * Ensure that you do not classify the file as Wash (Jeanologia) to prevent exporting the duplicated file when the same washing is applied to the double layer like the back pocket sewn into the back pattern. * You can set the washing file(JEAN) type to Wash or Breakage. (ver 6.1) [Go back to the List of Contents](-#Click)
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for importing and exporting JEAN files in eDesigner, enabling users to apply advanced laser washing techniques to garments efficiently.

title: Dart / Base Dart
content: ### Objective Create darts inside patterns. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Create ▶ **Dart / Base Dart**** **2D Toolbar ▶![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360061084034) **Dart /![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360061084054) Base Dart (ver 5.2)** **Operation** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated above. 2. Click and drag within a pattern to create a dart. 3. Or click once within the pattern. → The **Create Dart** window appears. 4. Enter the desired values for the following options. **Dimension** | Determine width (left), width (right), height (up), height (down). All values are measured from the center of the dart. ---|--- **Position** | **Outline** | Designate the dart's position within the pattern by entering the margin between the dart outline and the pattern outline (ver2.5.0). **Center** | Designate the dart's position within the pattern by entering the distance between the center of the dart and the pattern outline (ver2.5.0).
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for creating darts within patterns using the Dart tool in a 2D design environment.

title: Advanced Pinching
content: **New in CLO 2025.0 ** **Apply the Soft Selection options to the Pinching function during simulation.** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nq_oZNdlqF0?si=rhthmAWJb8SatCHi 1. Click the ![Simulation Normal On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44158677325209)**Simulate** tool in the 3D toolbar. 2. Click and hold the **![3D Select On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44158677334041)****Select/Move** tool for more than 2 seconds, then click the **![Advanced Pinching On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44158685113497)Advanced Pinching** tool. 3. Set the options in Advanced Pinch Settings window. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Range** | The shape graph reflects the selected Falloff(Shape/Distance/Power) and cannot be manipulated directly. **Falloff Shape** | Select the Falloff Shape: Bump or Linear ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44157625001753) **Falloff Distance** | Set the distance of the selection range to the radius: Min: 1, Max: 500 ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/46860016841497) **Falloff Power** | A value that sets the strength of falloff. (Min:-2.0, Max:+2.0) ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44157625003673) **Options** | **Distance Measure** | How the distance from the picking point is measured. Surface | When multiple layers of patterns are together, only one independent layer will be selected. Straight | Select all patterns within a certain distance from the picking point regardless of the layer selected. **Distance Indicator** | Indicates the Falloff Distance/Power values using 2 concentric circles around the pinch icon. When turned off the circles will disappear. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44157615799705) **Limit to Selected Patterns** | When the Distance Measure is set to **Straight** , the selection range is applied only to the initially selected pattern. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44157625008025) **Display Weights** | Display a contrasting color to the mesh where the weight value is applied. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44157615801113) 4. Modify the Range and Option values and freely pinch the pattern.
content_description: Discover how to enhance your simulation experience in CLO 2025.0 by utilizing the new Soft Selection options with the Advanced Pinching function for more precise pattern adjustments.

title: Omniverse Connector
content: **New in 2025.0** Add Server Create/Join Session Session in Progress Leave Session Easily exchange USD data via Omniverse Connect to enhance collaborative productivity. For more information on NVIDIA and Omniverse, please check out the links below. * [Create NVIDIA account](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/omniverse/) * [Download and install the Omniverse Launcher](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/omniverse/download/) * [Set the Omniverse server](https://docs.omniverse.nvidia.com/prod_nucleus/prod_nucleus/overview.html) #### **Add Server** You can add Omniverse Nucleus server in CLO. 1. Click Settings » Display » Window » Omniverse Connect in the top menu. 2. Click Omniverse icon » Add Sever, and enter the sever address. #### **Create/Join Session** 1. [ Import a USD file](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/29738864727449-USD-File-Import-Export-ver-2024-0#Click1) which from both Omniverse USD Composer and CLO to connect to the session. 2. Open the same file opend in CLO in Omniverse USD Composer » Content Tab. 3. Create a sesstion in Omniverse USD Composer » LIVE Icon → A session is succesfully created, and you are automatically joined that session with the LIVE icon is activated in Omniverse USD Composer. The Live Session Layer is displayed once you are joined the session. 4. Join the session in CLO » Omniverse Connector Window » Omniverse Icon » Join Session. → The layer from the session is added as a Live type in the USD Layer window. The layer will have the same name as the Live Session Layer in Omniverse USD Composer, and be set to the Authoring Layer. #### **Session in Progress** Export files from CLO to Omniverse USD Composer. When a session in Omniverse USD Composer is connected in CLO, you can export your work in CLO to Omniverse USD Composer through the Export to USD Layer feature. The way Omniverse USD Composer updates the work depends on the type of USD layer (USD, LIVE) that the Authoring Layer is set to. 1. Where the Live Session Layer is set as the Authoring Layer, select desired clothing or trims and click on Export to USD Layer from the right mouse button pop-up menu. → The changes of the session layer is directly reflected to the Omniverse USD Composer. _* Where a USD Layer is set as the Authoring Layer, the selected are exported to the USD file, but not directly reflected to the Omniverse USD Composer._ 2. To see these changes in the Omniverse USD Composer, click **FETCH** button when the 'Base USD files have been changed' pop-up appears. ![usd_fetch.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45594882482841) **📝****Note:** ▪️ If there is no Prim with the same name on the same Prim Path in Omniverse USD Composer, add a new Prim (Append). ▪️ If there is a Prim with the same name in the Prim Path you set for export in Omniverse USD Composer, the changes will be overwritten on that Prim. #### **Leave Session ** You can leave the session that you are in both CLO and Omniverse USD Composer. 1. Click the Omniverse Icon in Omniverse Connector » Leave Session. → The current session ends and the Live mark disappears from the Omniverse icon. The list of session participants disappears. 2. Click the Live Icon in Omniverse USD Composer in CLO » Leave Session. → The current session ends and the Live status is changed to deactivated. The list of session participants disappears. _**✨Tip:** _ Please try out this [USD sample file](https://s3.marvelousdesigner.com/newmdweb/helpcenter/manual/KoiFish_USD.zip) we created with CLO and see how the new USD support can benefit your workflow.
content_description: Explore the new features of Omniverse Connect in 2025.0 for seamless USD data exchange and enhanced collaborative productivity in CLO.

title: USD Layer Window
content: ## **New in 2025.0** Create/Open Set Options Export #### With USD, a graphics standard file format, you can increase collaboration productivity with a variety of 3D software. You can export clothing, avatars, and accessories with meshes and materials as USD files. You can also import USD files created in other 3D software packages into CLO. A list of layers for the imported file can be found in the USD Layer window. #### #### **Create/Open** 1. Click Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ Display ▶ Windows ▶ USD Layer. Or, right-click on the top of the side window, such as Object Browser or Property Editor. Create | Create an USD file \- An USD file is created with the specified path and name, appearing in the USD Layer window. This file will be set as the Authoring Layer. \- When exporting the Material, a Texture folder is created within the directory where the USD is saved. ---|--- Open | Import an USD file Clear | Delete all the layers listed in the USD Layer. 2. The list of created or opend USD layers is structured as follows. Authoring Layer | The default layer which is being used at the moment. \- When running Export to USD Layer for clothing, trims, scenes and props, they will be exported to the Authoring Layer. ---|--- Material | The default path where the Materials appear. \- Users can name this path while running Export to USD Layer. Mesh | The default path where the Mesh appears. \- Users can name this path while running Export to USD Layer. #### #### **Set Options** 1. Right-click on the layer list to set options if needed. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44171634932377) Set Authoring Layer | Set the selected layer as active. \- The same can be done by double clicking the left mouse button** **This menu won't appear in the following situations: \- Where the selected layer is already set as the Authoring Layer. \- Where the selected layer is an USDZ (read only) \- Where the selected layer is missing. ---|--- Delete | Deleted the selected layer. This menu won't appear in the following situations: \- Where the selected layer is the Authoring Layer. Export USDZ from Layer | Export the selected layer as USDZ (read only) Once an USDZ is imported, it cannot be exported again. #### #### **Export** To export your cloth and/or trim assets from CLO as a USD file; select the assets from either 3D or 2D window, and click "Export to USD Layer" of the object context menu to export them to the Authoring Layer. This will update the USD file corresponding to the Authoring Layer. 1. Set export options if needed. Prim | Mesh | Prim Path | Either select or deselect Mesh. \- You can name the Prim Path for the Mesh when exporting. ---|---|---|--- Material | Prim Path | Either select or deselect Material. \- You can name the Prim Path for the Material. \- When exporting the Material, a Texture folder is created within the folder where the USD is saved. All related textures will be saved in that Texture folder. Object | Single Object | Exports selected object as a single object. Multiple Objects | Exports selected object as multiple objects. Thin | Export USD without the rendering thickness. Thick | Export USD with the rendering thickness as Geometry. Unified UV Coordinates | Exports the texture data for all patterns to fit within UV coordinates Image Size | Set the size of the image in pixels Fill Texture Seams | Extend the scope of texture based on the texture's borders. Include Garment Simulation Data | USD export for garments, including the necessary data for simulation setup. Include Fur Strand Data | Include the Fur Strand information. Option | Cache Animation | Saves pattern cache animation. **📝****Note:** Since Pattern Cache Animation is exported as a mesh itself, there is no separate Animation Type prim. Avatar Animation | Joint | Saves the animation data for Avatar animation as skeletal animation. Avatar Animation is exported to the USD Layer Window as a SkelAnimation type below SkelRoot. Cache | Saves avatar cache animation. Basic | Scale | Set the unit of scale. % | Adjust the scale in percentage. Axis Conversion | Up Axis | Select the up-axis used in the application where the file was imported from. Marvelous Designer will compare the up-axis of the incoming file and apply conversion if necessary. **📝****Note:** In Marvelous Designer, the Y axis is the up-axis. **📝****Note:** When exporting garment using Export to USD Layer, the exported output will differ depending on the 3D Garment Rendering Style state. If the 3D garment appears in Thick Textured Surface, it will be exported with thickness.
content_description: This web page provides comprehensive guidance on the new USD functionality in CLO 2025.0, enabling users to create, open, and export 3D assets seamlessly for enhanced collaboration across various software platforms.

title: Color Window / How do I change colors in my project?
content: ## **Objective** Edit the color of different components in your scene: Fabrics, graphics, buttons, buttonholes, topstitches, puckering, avatars and avatar accessories, trims, zippers, imported files such as OBJs, etc. ## **Location** For components listed in the Object Browser: [Object Browser](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000374247-Object-Browser) ▶ Fabric/Graphic/Button/Buttonhole/Topstitch/Puckering/Trim Tab ▶ Item ▶ **Color** **All** components in the scene can be selected via the Scene tab in the Object Browser, however, to access their traits in the Property Editor, it also suffices to select the following in the 3D Window: **Avatars, shoes, hair, earrings, scene & props, zippers, imported components such as e.g. OBJs and FBXs, etc.** In the **Color** row, click on the color chip on the right. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/42486295176729) ## **Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline above: The color window opens. 2. Refer to the table below: ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360070124113) ### **Custom Palette** | ① Edit Color | Click the color you want to use from the color field or enter color values. ---|---|--- ② Eyedropper | Select the color you want to use from an image, inside of the program, or anything else visible on your screen. ③ Add Color | Add the selected color into the current Custom Palette. ④ Swatch Size | Adjust the size of swatches. ⑤ Open/Save File | Open or save color palette files. Compatible file formats for import: ACO, ASE, CCO, QTX. Note that you can only save color palettes in both the ACO and CCO file formats. (CCO is CLO-internal.) ⑥ Reset | Reset your current Custom Palette. ⑦ Change the View | Choose List, Detail, or Icon view to change the view. ⑧ Edit Color Swatch | Rename | Double-click the swatch to change the name. Reorder | Click & drag and drop the swatch to change the order. Delete | Click the swatch and remove it by hitting the Delete key on the keyboard. ### **** ### Palette Library | Other than the default palette, the Color Library provides the following color palettes: \- **Coloro** 3500 \- **Pantone** : Color Bridge Coated V5, Color Bridge Coated V5, Color Bridge Uncoated V5, Pastels & Neons Coated, FHI Polyester TSX, CMYK Uncoated, CMYK Coated, Solid Coated-V5, FHI Cotton TCX 2801, Solid Uncoated-V5, Pastels & Neons Uncoated, f+h nylon brights TN, METALLICS Coated \- **YKK** Global Colors ⑨ Add Palette File | Import palette files (ACO, ASE, CCO, QTX). ⑩ Search Color | Search via color name or code. ⑪ Add Color to Custom Palette | Add a color from the Palette Library to the Custom Palette. **※ Note:** Instantly change the color of another object by selecting it while the color window is open (ver 7.1).
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for users to edit and customize the colors of various components in their scene, including fabrics, graphics, and imported files, using the Object Browser and Property Editor in the software.

title: Object Browser
content: **View and edit items used in both 3D and 2D windows such as Scene, Fabrics, Graphics, Buttons, Buttonholes, Topstitches, Puckerings, and Trims. Grading and POMs can also be accessed here.** ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/42486747889945) **Scene** | The Scene tab is the most streamlined tool for finding or selecting a component in your scene. It lets you quickly review a list of all items and their structure in the 3D and 2D Windows. The list follows the order of creation. ---|--- **Fabric** | All fabrics used in and added to the scene. Users can select, add, copy and reset a fabric. Click and drag to reorder fabrics as desired (ver 4.1.0). **Graphic** | All graphics used in or added to the scene. Users can select, add, and copy graphics. **Button** | All buttons used in or added to the scene. Users can select, add, and copy Button. **Buttonhole** | All buttonholes used in or added to the scene. Users can select, add, and copy buttonholes. **Topstitch** | All topstitches used in or added to the scene. Users can select, add, and copy topstitches. **Puckering** | All puckerings used in or added to the scene. Users can select, add, and copy puckerings. **Trim** | All trims added to the scene. title: Set Graphic Options
content: Set CLO's Graphic Options.![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45588842971289)[Watch Video](https://youtu.be/laMem5VP5ro) 1. Click Setting ▶ User Settings ▶ **Graphic Options** in the top menu. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Antialiasing** | Set how smooth the outlines of objects appear. As the number increases, the outlines become smoother and the rendering speed becomes slower **Use VBOs** | Set the VBOs usage in order to improve the rendering speed. **** **Normal Blending ** | Choose how to blend the normal map. The normal map blending result is reflected in the 3D window and [UV Editor](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360053418574-UV-Editor-Mode-ver-6-0-). **Alpha Blending** A method that simulates the normal blending effect using the alpha value. **Partial Derivative** A method of blending the height map using partial derivatives of the normal map. **Whiteout** A technique optimized to reduce the amount of computation and it is a way to preserve detail while maintaining the tendency of a relatively flat normal. **UDN** Compared to Whiteout and Reoriented, the detail of the normal map is slightly reduced but the optimized calculation method is useful for low-end platforms. **Reoriented** A method that preserves the intensity of all mixed normal maps while maintaining the trend of the flat normal map and the details of the complex normal map well. This is the most accurate and slow method by rotating the normal of the detail to match the normal of the base. **Unity** It is the same method as reoriented but the error in certain situations (when two mixed normals are orthogonal) is abandoned and the performance is improved. **Image Resolution Setting** | ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45588844260889) Set the maximum image resolution for the rendering. The Image that exceed the set resolution is downscaled only while rendering to optimize performance. The higher the image resolution, the more memory CLO requires to render and process.
content_description: Explore how to customize CLO's graphic options to enhance rendering quality and performance in your designs.

title: Self-Service Refunds Within 24 Hours of First Billing After Free Trial
content: CLO offers self-service refunds under specific conditions. If you're an individual user, you may request a refund within 24 hours of your first billing after the free trial ends. During this 24-hour window, your refund request will be automatically approved. ⚠️ Please note: ➤ The self-refund option is only available within 24 hours of your first paid billing after the free trial. ➤ Your subscription must still be active to request a refund. If you cancel your subscription before requesting a refund, the self-service option will no longer be available. #### #### **Refund Eligibility** * Applies only to individual users * Valid for the first paid billing after the free trial * Refund must be requested within 24 hours of that billing #### #### **How to request a refund:** You can request a refund in either of the following ways: Option 1: From your account 1. Go to your **[Subscription]** page 2. Click "Request Refund" within 24 hours of your first charge 3. Your subscription will be cancelled and your refund will be processed instantly Option 2: From the billing confirmation email 4. If your subscription has just renewed after the free trial, you’ll receive a confirmation email. 5. This email includes a "Request Refund" button that is valid for 24 hours only. 6. Clicking the button will cancel your subscription and trigger an instant refund. #### #### **Didn't request a refund but got a confirmation?** If you receive a refund confirmation email without having requested one, or notice any suspicious activity, please reach out to CLO via [Contact Us](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus).
content_description: This web page provides essential information on how individual users can quickly and easily request a self-service refund within 24 hours of their first paid billing after a free trial.

title: [Important Notice] Student Account Review
content: As part of our ongoing account review process, student members who have received student discount benefits for a period of four years are required to undergo additional verification to extend their discount benefits. Please review the information below regarding the next steps for your account. **IF YOU HAVE ALREADY GRADUATED:** Cancel your student plan if they are still active (you can use all of the remaining days before the license expires). Before canceling, be sure to save all files to a local drive to prevent data loss. To continue with a CLO subscription: * Sign up to clo3d.com using your personal email, and re-subscribe to a plan of your choice. Or * If your student account is integrated with CLO-SET with NO ACTIVE subscription, you can simply request [Change Email from CLO-SET](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/31866962710169-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET) to a new email address and proceed to subscribe to a plan of your choice. **IF YOU ARE STILL IN SCHOOL:** Please subject the following documents to [Contact Us](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus) for verification: 1\. A copy of your official enrollment letter, including an official academic stamp, or a current class schedule that shows your name. 2\. A copy of your current student ID card. Upon approval, we will extend your student account for an additional 2 years. _Please note that after this period you will no longer be eligible for a student discount, as we have a six-year cap on student accounts._ **DEADLINE:** To avoid interruption of service, please ensure we receive your enrollment documentation before the date that's provided via your email. If we do not receive your submission by that date, your student account will be canceled immediately. If you have any questions or need further assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out via [CONTACT US](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus).
content_description: This page outlines the necessary steps for student members to verify their eligibility for continued discount benefits after four years, including instructions for both graduates and current students.

title: Edit Topstitch
content: **List of Contents** Move Properties Edit the topstitches to adjust their length or change settings. #### **Move** 1. Click ![Edit Topstitch On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45467813423257) **Edit Topstitch** tool in the 2D toolbar. 2. Click and drag a point or a whole segment of the Topstitch to be edited. → The Topstitch is moved to the position. #### **Properties** * **Topstitch Style** 1. Select the Topstitch Style to change the properties. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Information** | Enter the information of trim. **Type** | Set the Topstitch type to Texture or OBJ. **Offset** | Adjust the interval between Topstitches on Internal Lines or Pattern outlines. **Stitch Count** | Create various different types of Topstitches up to five at a time. **Use Same Specification/ Material** | This option to configure multiple topstitches' Specification and Materials. **Specification**** **| **Shape** | Set the shape of Topstitch. _**✨Tip:** _Click the Add OBJ Topstitch button on the right to add and use your OBJ as a Topstitch. **[![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/25701546478617)](https://youtu.be/r60uueH5eeE?si=_9no49K1GmzWTThI&t=3975)**[Watch Video](https://youtu.be/r60uueH5eeE?si=_9no49K1GmzWTThI&t=3975) Set the Lenth(SPI), Space, Thread Thickness of the Topstitch. SPI stands for Stitch Per Inch, meaning the number of stitches within an inch. For example, 'SPI-4' means there are four individual stitches within an inch. For standard garments, SPI-11 is often being used. **Material** | Partially set the [material](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Textures) of Topstitch. **Configuration**** **| **Face** | Select the face of Topstitch. **Number of Lines** | Set how many lines of Topstitches there are for a single style. **Distance** | It is possible to adjust the distance between the lines. The unit of the length can be set in inch, millimeter(mm) or centimeter(cm). **3D** | The Topstitch is more realistic in the 3D window. **Polygon Optimization** | ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45467927193625) When the Type is set to OBJ, the polygon count is optimized based on the value you enter to improve performance. ![20 Topstitch I Polygon Optimization.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45467984687129) ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45467813424921) * **T****opstitch** 1. Click on the Topstitch created in the pattern to change its properties individually. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Topstitch Property** | Change the style of the selected Topstitch. **Extend** | When the start or end point of a Topstitch does not reach or sticks out of the Pattern outline, extend it to fit to the Pattern. **Corner**** **| **Curved** | Set Topstitch corner type to extend the stitch more smoothly at corners. **Right Angled** | Set the Topstitch to be a right angle in the corner of the pattern. **Smooth ** | Set it to continue naturally if the edge of the Topstitch is broken. **Offset** | Set the Z Offset of the Topstitch. **Placement** | Use the Flip function to set a Topstitch on an Internal Shape/Line in a different direction (inside and outside). Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to move and edit topstitch properties in your design software, including adjusting length, style, and configuration settings.

title: Avatar IK Joint Mapping
content: ## **New in 2025.0** IK Joint Mapping Set T-Pose Open/Save #### Streamline IK joint mapping for various avatars to achieve natural movement while ensuring seamless compatibility for motions and poses across all avatars. The avatar must have properly defined joint points. Rigging must include key joints such as shoulders, elbows, wrists, pelvis, knees, and ankles. YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UvWChktL4ZU?si=hBC_fnvPaBX1VwUb #### #### **IK Joint Mapping** **ℹ️** The FBX file must not contain joints with duplicate names, and IK mapping may not apply correctly for creatures or quadruped avatars with non-human structures. 1\. Click Main Menu » Avatar » Avatar Editor » **IK Joint** tab. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44695163389593)** Joints are categorized into required and optional, and you must map all required joints to ensure proper IK setup. ![IK.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44695503254809) For optional joints, we recommend mapping those indicated in the image if they are present in the avatar to achieve more accurate results. ![IK_Optional.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44698897617177) **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44695163389593)** **Auto** If the avatar meets the following conditions, click **![Auto Mapping.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44695163400089)**at the top right to apply automatic mapping. • If each joint name of the avatar matches that of the CLO avatar. • If the avatar is from one of the following platforms: **Daz 3D, Adobe Mixamo, Reallusion Character Creator, or Unreal Engine MetaHuman.** **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44695163389593)** **Manual** 1. Click the desired item from the image or list in the IK Mapping tab, then click the joint to be mapped on the avatar. _* Alternatively, you can first click the joint on the avatar and then click an item from the tab._ 2. When ![IK Symmetric.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44695147316505)**S****ymmetry Mapping** option at the top right is turned on, the corresponding joint on the opposite side is automatically mapped. Note that both sides must be named as follows: **Left_** / **Right_, L_ / R_** , **Left / Right** , **_L / _R** , **_Left / _Right. ** 3. Once all mapping is set up, adjust the [IK pose.](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115009052548-Adjust-Avatar-Joints#h_01J90BEJ6RBW7SQZXTSHZZSA80) **✨Tip:** Use the following tips to enhance the motion quality on the target avatar after IK mapping. • Offset Joint: If a specific joint does not align properly, adjust the avatar joints by using [Offset Joint](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/39336772755737-Offset-Avatar-Joint). • Move to Ground: If the avatar is floating above the ground after applying a motion file, right-click on the avatar and click 'Move to Ground'. #### #### **Set T-Pose** Set the avatar in a T-pose to ensure proper compatibility with CLO avatar pose and motion files apply correctly. 1. Adjust the avatar’s joints directly to a T-pose using the gizmo in the 3D window. _If the avatar is already in a T-pose, this step can be skipped._ 2. Click **![Set T-Pose.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44695147319449)** at the top right. **📝****Note:** • If set correctly, the ![Reset Pose.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44698897618329) button activates, allowing you to check the set T-pose when cilcked. • After adjusting the pose during IK mapping, click the Reset Pose button to revert the avatar to the set T-pose. #### #### **Open/Save** You can manage the IK data mapped to the avatar as a file. 1. Click ![Button-1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44695147320473) **Save** / ![Button.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44695163440025)**Open** at the top right to open or save IK data as a _.iks_ file. * IK files are only compatible between avatars that have been mapped.
content_description: Discover the new IK Joint Mapping Set in 2025.0, designed to enhance avatar movement and compatibility by streamlining the mapping process for natural poses and motions across various avatars.

title: AI Pose Generator (Beta)
content: **New in 2025.0** **** Effortlessly create avatar poses using keywords or an image. _ ***** AI Pose Generator is being piloted as a Beta service, and may be suspended to provide better service. _ YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcyka3wCgug?si=TQxBJ2n7TfVBT8fG **** 1. Click Avatar ▶ **AI Pose Generator** in the top menu. 2. Generate a pose image by entering prompts or upload it directly. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Text Prompt** | Select the gender, and enter your prompt. **✨ Writing Tips: **Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. ![Comment.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45587833642521)**Keyword Suggestions** | Suggested keywords will appear as you type to help you complete your prompt. ![icon_pin_off.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45587817802265)**Maintain Prompt** | Even if the same prompts are used, the AI pose image is created anew each time. Thus, clicking the Maintain Prompt button may update the prompts while preserving the existing results as much as possible. The results may differ from the existing ones depending on the addition or change of the prompts. ![icon_random_dice.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45587833646873) **Random** | Sample prompts are provided randomly **Image** | Click the **Upload** button to load a pose image that fits the following guidelines: A full-body image from head to toe is highly recommended to ensure the highest quality of the AI Pose. 3. Click **![Generate.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45588063371673)** Button to generate the pose based on your image. It may take a while to create when there are many users at the same time. 4. Click ![Save.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45588079659033) Button to save the generated pose as the *.pos file.
content_description: Discover the innovative AI Pose Generator, allowing you to effortlessly create unique avatar poses using keywords or images, now in Beta for enhanced user experience.

title: Line (3D Pattern)
content: **List of Contents** Line (3D Pattern) Create Line (3D Pattern) **Line (3D Pattern)** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r4zF03lHmww \- Draw lines on draped 3D Garment in the 3D Window. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022472148/mceclip0.png) **Line (3D Pattern)** tool from the 3D toolbar. ** Create Line(3D Pattern)** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LU2k-oOKYp4 \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022472148/mceclip0.png) **Line (3D Pattern)** tool from the 3D toolbar. \- Click on 3D Garment where the start point of the line should be created. \- Move the mouse as a yellow point follows along and a black segment connecting two points is created. \- Click as needed to create desired shape of line. \- Hold down the Ctrl key on the keyboard to create the curve. \- Double click the end point or click the start point again to create a line or a shape, respectively. \- As the line or the shape is completed, it will be highlighted in yellow. \- The created line or shape will appear on 3D Garment and on 2D Pattern as baseline. title: Stress Map
content: \- The **Stress Map** shows any stress applied onto garments; check the force along the fabric grain per unit area on garments. \- Hover over the third icon in the Vertical Toggle Menu in the 3D window. Then, Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001846908/CLT_Group_06Strain_Normal.png)**Stress Map** icon. \- Any part not under stress will appear in blue, but under stress, that part of the garment will turn closer to red. \- There is a common misconception that Stress is Pressure. For evaluating external pressure being applied to the avatar, please use the [Pressure Map](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000436368-Garment-Fit-Maps) instead.
content_description: Explore the **Stress Map** to visualize stress distribution on garments, identifying areas under tension with a color gradient from blue (no stress) to red (high stress).

title: Topstitch Item/Property
content: **List of Contents** Topstitch Item Topstitch Item List Editing Topstitch Item Utilizing Topstitch Item **Topstitch Item ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=siDrzKHsQYE \- Create and edit Topstitch items. \- Navigate to Object Browser – **Topstitch** Tab ******Topstitch Item List** \- Default_Topstitch is part of the program asset which is created upon download. It is fixed in the list and cannot be deleted. * **Adding Topstitch Item YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GsN1Gzuc568 ** \- Navigate to Object Browser ▶ Topstitch Tab ▶ **Add** Button \- A new Topstitch item is created. * **Duplicating Topstitch Item YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9ZIY93haZnc **\- Click on the Topstitch item to be duplicated. \- The **Copy** button above the Topstitch List is activated. \- Click the Copy button as a duplicated Topstitch will be created at the bottom of the list. * **Deleting Topstitch Item YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Egq5lKl3d9U ** \- Only unused Topstitch item can be deleted. \- Click on the **Delete** icon located at the right side of the Topstitch item. \- Or right-click on the Topstitch item to access the pop-up menu. Select **Delete.** **Editing Topstitch Item** \- Select the Topstitch item to be edited and navigate to Object Browser. * **Name YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xwLXzzKZOmM ** \- Change name for the selected Topstitch item. * **Type YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gQnINA0EvTc ** \- There are two types of Topstitches: **OBJ** and **Texture**. ** -** Select desired option. * **Material YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RuPI4QrEPjU ** * **Preset** \- Select shapes of Topstitches among provided options: **Custom** , **Bartack** , **Buttonhole** , **Overlock** ,**Pickstitch** , **Single** , **Single_Offset_0** , **Zigzag**. \- When either Buttonhole or Overlock is selected, an additional option **Stitch Width** will appear. * **Color** \- Click on the color chip to change Topstitch color. \- Click on the drop-down arrow next to **Color** to access child options: **Ambient Intensity** and **Diffuse Intensity.** \- Adjust each option as needed. * **Offset** \- Commonly used offset values are provided as preset. \- Input specified value as needed. \- The unit corresponds to the unit that is currently used in CLO. * **Length(SPI)** \- Adjust the length of each Stitch. \- **SPI** is the abbreviation for Stitch per Inch. As SPI increases, each Stitch length shortens. \- Input specified stitch length as needed. * **Thread Thickness** \- Adjust the Thickness of the Thread manually. \- Expand the drop down menus by clicking the Arrow button. \- Choose the desired unit used for Thread Thickness among Tex, Ticket (Tkt,) Metric (Nm,) Denier (Den,) and Millimeter. \- When Preset is set as **Pickstitch** , a child option is added to adjust distance in between each Stitch. * **Face** \- Choose the Topstitch’s placement on the fabric: **Front** , **Back** , **Both** * **Number of Line** \- Assign number of lines for a Topstitch item. \- When more than two lines are created, a child option **Distance** will appear. Use this option to adjust the apart distance of lines. \- Select among provided values or input custom values as needed. * **Multilayered Topstitch YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W-ZdopXkaAY ** \- When a Topstitch item is created, only one layer is created by default. \- To create multilayered Topstitch, click the + tab next to 1 tab. \- Toggle On **Use This Stitch** option. The options will be activated. \- Adjust options as needed. \- As many as five layers of Stitches can be created to express complicated Stitch styles such as Color Overlock. * **Multilayered Topstitch_ver.4.1.0 and Above YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qciKwUC2WNw ** \- Create various different types of Topstitches up to five at a time. \- Choose the desired number of Topstitch lines using the drop down menu next to Stitch Count. \- To configure multiple lines of a single Topstitch style at the same time, toggle on below options as needed. \- **Use Same Specification** : Toggle on this option to configure multiple topstitches' Specification related options such as Shape, Length, Space and more at the same time. \- **Use Material** : Toggle on this option to configure multiple topstitches' Material related options such as Texture, Color, Type and more at the same time. * **Default Topstitch Tread Thickness Unit_ver.4.2.0 and avobe YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S-E1LfsdUtA ** \- Change the default unit for Topstitch thickness. \- Navigate to Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶ User Interface ▶ Default Topstitch Thread Thickness Unit \- Select the desired unit among five options. * **Space_ver.4.2.0 and avobe YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PpIYHX8U0_Q ** \- Set the distance between each stitch of Topstitch style. \- The Space value can be both negative and positive values. **Utilizing Topstitch Item ** * **Saving/Opening Topstitch Item YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=keaitLUSI8M ** \- Select the Topstitch item to be saved. \- Click on the **Save** button at the top of the properties. \- A file browser will appear. Designate file name and path, and then click on the **Save** button. \- The Topstitch item will be saved as .sst format. \- To open a Topstitch item, select the **Open** button at the top of the properties. \- When a file browser appears, located and open the Topstitch item to be opened. * **Applying Topstitch Item YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WAdBP9OrjtY ** \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024511568/mceclip0.png) **Edit Topstitch** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Then, navigate to 2D window and select on the Topstitch line created on 2D Pattern. The selected Topstitch line will be highlighted in pink. \- Click **Assign** button. \- The selected Topstitch item will be applied to the Topstitch line created on 2D Pattern. \- Or right-click on the Topstitch line on 2D Pattern to access a pop-up menu. \- Select **Assign** to New Topstitch. \- A new Topstitch item is created as it is automatically assigned to the selected Topstitch line on 2D Pattern. ([Reference Editing Topstitch](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013749468)) Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for creating, editing, and utilizing Topstitch items, complete with instructional videos and step-by-step instructions.

title: Compatible File Format
content: **Compatible File Format **** ** **File** | **Format** | **Import** | **Export** | **Detail** ---|---|---|---|--- **3D** | **FBX** | *.fbx | O | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, and Camera information. **COLLADA** | *.dae | O | X | This file can be exported from other 3D softwares such as 3ds Max, Maya, Pose, and DAZ Studio and used. These files contain geometry and material, also in a addition to rigging, skinning, and animation data When exporting COLLADA files from 3DS Max or Maya, install the “OpenCOLLADA plugin ([http://www.opencollada.org/download.html](http://www.opencollada.org/download.html)) and export to use the avatar **OBJ** | *.obj | O | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Primarily used for importing Avatar and related sources into the program. **LXO** | *.lxo | X | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Used to export Apparel/Avatar information to Modo in the LXO file format. **Animation Cache** | *.mc *.pc2 *.mdd | O | O | Is the vertex animation data. It is possible to take animations made in CLO 3D to 3DSMax or Maya in point cache format. **Alembic** | *.abc | O | O | Is an interchange file format for computer graphics that saves both vertex and animation information. **2D** | **DXF-AAMA** | *.dxf *.aam | O | O | Is the standard format of industry CAD patterns and contains 2D Pattern information. CLO 3D is currently compatible with DXF files such as YUKA, Gerber, Lextra, StyleCAD, Optitex, and Pad System **DXF-ASTM** | *.dxf | O | O **Texture** | *.jpg, *.png, etc. | O | O | Textures inserted into garments, use image textures in formats such as JPG, PNG, TIF, and PSD. Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, wbmp, psd, ico, tga, tif, tiff, gif, mng, jng, dds, hdr, koa, lbm, iff, pbm, pcd, pcx, pgm, ppm, ras, cut, xmb, xpm, sgi, g3, exr, j2k, jp2, pfm, pict, pct) ※Note: Texture files compatible with V-ray Render are: hdr, exr, png, bmp, tga, sgi, jpg, pic, and psd. (V-ray does not support 32bit format of jpeg.) **2D Snapshot** | *.png | - | O | Ability to export patterns (of the 2D window) in a 1:1 scale PNG file. **3D Snapshot** **3D Multiview** | *.png | - | O | Ability to save single and/or multiple views of the 3D window in the PNG file format. **Video** | *.avi | - | O | Ability to capture and export videos of the 3D window in the AVI file format. ****
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive overview of compatible file formats for importing and exporting various 2D and 3D assets in CLO 3D, detailing their usage and requirements.

title: Fabric
content: **List of Contents** Fabric Add Fabric Item Copy Fabric Item Assign Fabric Item Reset Fabric Item Delete Fabric Item **Fabric ** \- In CLO, Fabric can be created just like how it is created in real life, applying texture to material properties. ** Add Fabric Item** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Kzq-xA0dlU4 ** * **The Add Button** \- Click the Add button on the Object Browser’s Fabric Tab. \- A new Fabric Item will be added to the Object Browser. * **Drag & Drop** \- Drag and Drop the Fabric file from the Desktop to the Object Browser. \- The selected file will be added to the Fabric list as a Fabric Item. * **Add From the Library Window** \- When there is a Fabric file in the Library Window, double-click the Fabric file to open. \- The dialogue will appear to inform the user that the file has been added to the Object Browser. The selected file will be added to the Object Browser as a Fabric Item. **Copy Fabric Item** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=au3lb4_IB-g** \- Select the Fabric Item to be duplicated from the Object Browser. \- Click the Copy button on the right side of the Fabric Item. \- A new Fabric Item will be added having the same material properties with the selected Fabric Item. **Assign Fabric Item** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZRZwQfiLpho** \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022307188/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021992087/mceclip0.png) **Edit Pattern** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Navigate to the 2D window and select the Pattern that a new Fabric Item will be applied to. \- Locate and click the Assign button on the right top of the Object Browser. \- A new Fabric Item will be added to the Object Browser and it will be automatically applied to the selected Pattern. **Reset Fabric Item** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mCtXrpTFhTA** \- Right-click on a Fabric Item which its settings will be reset and select **Reset.** \- All settings such as texture, color, and material properties will be changed to default values. **Delete Fabric Item** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h4rv0BgtRgk** \- A Fabric Item can be deleted and the Delete icon will appear only when it is not applied to any Pattern. If the fabric Item is applied to any Pattern, it cannot be deleted and the Delete icon will disappear. \- When the Delete icon does not appear next to the Fabric Item to be deleted, resolve the issue by following the steps below: \- Select the Fabric Item to be deleted from the Object Browser. The Patterns applied with the selected Fabric Item will be highlighted in pink. \- Navigate to the 2D window and right click on any Pattern highlighted in pink. Then, click Select All with Same Property ▶ **Fabric** \- Apply other Fabric Items to the selected Patterns. * **Delete Icon ** \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022307728/mceclip1.png) **Delete** icon next to the Fabric Item. \- The selected Fabric Item will be deleted from the Object Browser. * **Delete Option from the Right Click Pop-up Menu ** \- Right-click on the Fabric Item to be deleted and select **Delete** from the pop-up window. \- The selected Fabric Item will be deleted from the Object Browser. ** ** * **Delete key on Keyboard ** \- Click the Fabric Item to be deleted and hit the **Delete** key on the keyboard. \- The selected Fabric Item will be deleted from the Object Browser. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for managing fabric items in CLO, detailing the processes for adding, copying, assigning, resetting, and deleting fabrics within the software.

title: Edit V-Ray Light Properties
content: Configure the light properties for the final render image. [![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45588624495001) Watch Tutorial Video](https://youtu.be/ume5lYEU9hc) 1. Click ![Light Properties On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45588624503961)**Light Properties** in thr Render toolbar. 2. Refer to the below table and edit the light properties in Property Editor as needed. It is recommended to use only necessary lights as the number of lights increase, the render speed may slow down. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Preset ** | Set the Preset for the light. When hovering the mouse over each presets, you can check the result of applying light in advance. ** ****Overall** | **Name** | ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45588523657753) Set custom names for render lights to easily identify them. **Intensity/Color** | Adjust the intensity and color of the light. **Activate** | Activate or deactivate the light. **Show** | Show or hide the light. Sphere, rectangle, and dome lights can be shown or hidden separately in the 3D/Render window. **Dome Light** | **Environment Map** | Load an Environment Map. Environment Map refers to light settings processed as an image (HDR). **Light Angle** | Adjust the angle of the light shines on Avatars. **Rectangle Light (Three-Point Light)** | **Width/ Height** | Adjust the width and height of the Rectangle Lights. * To create a three-dimensional render image, there must be a key light. Add key lights as needed to create more dynamic images. * When the Rectangle Lights are used along with the Dome Light, generally, a Rectangle Light is used as a key light. Thus, when using Rectangle Lights in combination with the Dome Light, use a HDRI image without a bright spot which acts as a key light. **Sphere Light** | **Radius** | Set the radius of the Sphere Light. **Spot Light** | **Cone Angle** | Adjust the angle of the Spot Light. The higher the value is, the wider the light area is. ![Cone_Angle.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360057379574) **Penumbra Angle** | Adjust the penumbra angle. The higher the value is, the blended the light is. ![Penumbra_Angle.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360058215273) **Shadow Radius** | Adjust the sharpness of the shadow. The higher the value is, the blended the shadow is. ![Shadow_Radius.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360057380494) **IES Light** | **IES File** | Load an IES light file. An IES file stores the data of the brightness and shape of the actual light in real-life. **Intensity (lm)** | Specified: The light intensity of the file is applied as-is. Custom: Adjust the light's intensity as needed. **Ground Shadow** | Show or hide shadows on the ground. **Open/Save** | Open or Save the setting as a file.
content_description: Configure and customize your light properties for optimal final render images with our comprehensive guide and tutorial video.

Internal Shape will be duplicated. \- Right click on the 2D window and select **Paste** from the pop-up menu. \- The duplicated Internal Shape will follow along the mouse cursor. \- Click within the Pattern to Paste the Internal Shape. \- The identical Internal Shape will be created in the 2D window. ** Paste with Specific Values** * **Paste a Pattern** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sLohWrXuAZE \- Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021447968/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or
